formula: c=mean(original native MLP activations)/squared_norm(mean); v=period readout direction orthogonal to common competing tokens, normalized for unit raw-period-logit change; delta_period=6*median(original/attempt6 diagnostic RMS)*v*cT. This same numerical transformation applies to every prompt.
scope: Global sentence completion; no fact-specific termination rule, no EOS value programmed, no runtime response lookup.
precision: F32 modified tensor; F32 inference in both conditions
limitation: Could shorten or damage unrelated multi-sentence answers. Such regressions must be reported; empty answers, incomplete names and truncated responses do not count as factual corrections.
